summary: Milestone 2026.05.151 completed 19 experiments in 40.9 minutes. Synthesis-only tasks dominated the slowest experiments list, while the 2 compute-bound tasks did not appear as bottlenecks.
bottlenecks_identified: Synthesis-only tasks (e.g., Exp 1934 and Exp 1935) were the primary bottlenecks, not compute-bound operations.
improvements_suggested: Optimize synthesis-only processes as they represent the longest-running tasks.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Profile and accelerate the ConsFormer Iterative Refinement Loop synthesis.
Investigate the Continuous Latent Sampler Prototype synthesis phase for performance gains.
Ensure future compute-bound tasks utilize GPUs effectively, though no current bottlenecks exist there.
meta_reflection: The milestone was highly synthesis-heavy, and our primary delays were non-GPU tasks. We should focus on optimizing the synthesis pipelines to reduce overall wall time.
